node.text:
[size=64][color=#ffe7b8]Legacy of the Wardens[/color][/size] a demo of the Crossfire Engine and Editor
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Made with[/color][/size] The Crossfire Engine and the Crossfire Editor crossfireengine.io
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Art[/color][/size] Legacy Fantasy: High Forest, by Anokolisa anokolisa.itch.io (used with permission)
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Sound effects[/color][/size] GameSounds, by GameBurp (used with permission)
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Music[/color][/size] Synthesized for this demo (tools/demo/make_sounds.py)
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Fonts[/color][/size] Pixelify Sans, by Stefie Justprince (SIL Open Font License) Jacquarda Bastarda 9, by The Soft Type Project (SIL Open Font License)
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Levels[/color][/size] Built in LDtk's format (ldtk.io), by Sebastien Benard and contributors
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Libraries[/color][/size] SDL3, SDL_image, SDL_ttf, SDL_mixer; Box2D; FreeType The Odin programming language
[size=34][color=#ffd34d]Thank you for playing[/color][/size]
